title: TechCraftProject
description: This is the modpack for the TechCraft survival youtube project.
body:
# TechCraft
This is the official modpack for the TechCraft Survival YouTube Project.

# What's Inside
TechCraft brings together a balanced selection of performance, utility and quality-of-life mods.

Some included mods:
- Performance: Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, Clumps and more
- Utility & Exploration: Xaeros World Map, Xaeros Minimap and Controlling
- Visual Enhancements: Distant Horizons for stunning render distance and Gamma Utils for better visibility
- Additions: Graves and Haul
